propositions: pytest-timeout with thread method kills xdist worker on macOS py3.13 when test_rendered_output_is_byte_identical_to_the_landed_renderer exceeds 300s budget under CPU contention
test walks entire corpus of 884 units in a single monolithic loop, performing ~1768 serial pandoc spawns, measuring 91.6s idle and 504.8s under saturation (1.7x timeout bound)
worker crash manifests as 'node down: Not properly terminated' with no traceback; the 14-minute gap between kill and failure report is a reporting artifact (remaining session time), not kill latency
solution chunks the test by corpus index into fixed-size batches (_EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40) using pytest parametrize, keeping per-case cost bounded regardless of corpus growth
coverage guard test_the_equivalence_chunks_cover_every_renderable_unit ensures all 884 units are still compared with real pandoc at stride 1, preserving byte-identity property
fix reduces worst case from 504.8s to 38.05s under identical saturation (7.9x headroom), allowing xdist to spread work across workers rather than pinning to one
